description: Shortcut for a specific failure: github-mcp returning 401 after a PAT is configured. Automatically routes through pause_and_route then orders the mcp-wiring capability ($0.05 USDC), which returns the full PAT scope, stdio path, and SSE wiring guide. Requires a session_id from enter_lounge. Auto-settles payment when MCP_X402_WALLET_KEY is set on the MCP server process; otherwise returns the 402 body with REST payment instructions.
name: github_mcp_401_fix
title: github-mcp 401 fix shortcut
